releases.title: System version controls and one Windows installer
releases.summary: Version and update controls now live in Settings, System. Updates are checked automatically but downloaded and installed only when you choose, with progress and a clear restart step. Windows now uses one web installer that downloads the latest application package.
highlights: See the installed version, available version, last check, and update status in Settings, System.
Check for updates manually or let the automatic check notify you once per new version.
Download only when you choose, follow the percentage in the upgrade screen, then restart and install.
See an in-app banner for available and ready updates without losing the Settings status.
Use one Windows web installer for every release; it installs the latest application package at install time.
Replace an existing SKS DESIGNZ installation with a confirmation prompt while keeping settings and data.
Keep DESIGNZ capabilities, product identity, saved data, and the existing update channel.

releases.title: Independent plugin library and role access
releases.summary: SKS DESIGNZ now installs, updates, and launches its plugin applications from an independent library. Administrators can limit which plugins appear for each staff role.
highlights: Install, update, and remove plugin applications without replacing SKS DESIGNZ.
Open MeshX, StudioX, SLIDEX, SpreadX, and DocsX as independent applications.
Use versioned managed installs with SHA-256 verified Windows packages and rollback.
See an in-app notice when a newer plugin release is available, then update manually.
Hide plugin applications that the signed-in staff role is not allowed to use.
Keep existing source-folder installs available while managed installs are adopted.
Keep Tabiix outside the DESIGNZ product boundary and preserve saved data.

releases.title: Cleaner focused creative workspace
releases.summary: Plugin snapshots and desktop packaging are isolated from Cookbook and excluded modules while DESIGNZ retains its required shell and creative runtime support.
highlights: Keep plugin snapshots independent of Cookbook discovery and packaging.
Restore required desktop shell source and the supported test source view.
Keep Cookbook, TabiiX and Social outside the DESIGNZ product boundary.
Preserve DESIGNZ identity, saved data, creative tools and existing update channels.

releases.title: Updated creative and CAD workspace
releases.summary: Current LAB shared features arrive in SKS DESIGNZ, with a focused workspace for creative and CAD work.
highlights: Use StudioX and MeshX through approved company MuAPI models.
Follow affordable specialist defaults and fallbacks, with personal settings and reset controls.
Use current chat, local speech, CAD, Materials and Frame improvements.
Company, Social and Deep Research are disabled in this edition for now; saved data is retained.
Preserve this application identity, private data directory, themes and update channel.

releases.title: DESIGNZ shared source update
releases.summary: Shared chat, settings, Frame, Materials and CAD/Design improvements are now included in DESIGNZ source. Source update only: version 0.1.16 is unchanged. No new installers; existing downloads retain their published versions.
highlights: Choose shared endpoints and use improved direct replies, attachments, follow-up handling and live action feedback.
Keep plugin windows owned by the app, fit Frame content and use the Materials overlay.
Use shared CAD precision and Design production/model controls while retaining DESIGNZ identity and capabilities.
Choose Design from the premium mode selector and retain its design workflow.
Keep a single Mei Xin visible when switching modes.
See the application name beside the mini companion in compact window mode.

releases.title: Mei Xin follows through. Clearer Smart View.
releases.summary: Mei Xin completes authorized chat actions and presents Ask, Plan and CAD with clear mode icons, while retaining browser and Frame controls. Source/version notes only; no new installers. Existing downloads retain their published versions.
highlights: Open and inspect real browser screens from the initial tool set.
Ask to show Frame or select an existing owned screen without opening a duplicate session.
Keep browser text and DOM observations usable with text-only models; send screenshots only to models advertising image input.
Text fetching reports content-only evidence and no longer advertises itself as opening a website.
Preserve screen ownership, closed screens, control leases and certificate verification.
Continue authorized actions after progress text and confirm completion after tool calls.
Use clear mode icons and descriptions, with the companion hidden in Ask, Plan and CAD.
Keep Mei Xin branding and artwork, product identity and existing browser/Frame capabilities.

releases.title: Window mode restored. SKS SI Beta.
releases.summary: The compact top-right Frame preview returns in the installed desktop app, with SKS SI startup branding and a clear Beta label.
highlights: Switch Frame into Window mode for a small floating preview at the top-right of your workspace.
Expand the same screen back beside Chat without reloading the editor or losing its layout and pane width.
Remember Window mode after reload; passive previews capture only the selected screen and never resize the native application.
See SKS SI branding and Beta version information during both native startup and the sign-in check.
Identify the Beta release in the app header, sign-in screen and Settings information page while keeping automatic updates enabled.

releases.title: A clearer plugin library. Your account in view.
releases.summary: A refreshed Plugins page, verified account photos and consistent provider and model artwork throughout the desk.
highlights: Browse a cleaner plugin library with search, status filters, working controls and real editor previews inside the cards.
Use a text-led Plugins header and a native toolbar without decorative banner images.
Show your verified Google account photo in the toolbar, sidebar and account settings, with initials if the photo is unavailable.
See provider and model logos in catalogs, model details and company models, with clear provider artwork when a model has no individual image.
Cloud-app availability still depends on vendor approval; this release does not enable public Google or Figma access.

releases.title: A clearer Workspace. Real app previews.
releases.summary: Fresh geometric identities and actual interface previews for Deep Research, Calendar and Kanban.
highlights: New matching logos for Deep Research, Calendar and Kanban in the Workspace library, sidebar and app headers.
Real application screenshots with labelled sample projects replace the decorative illustrations.
Full 16:9 previews remain visible, with cleaner cards in both light and dark appearances.
Sample previews stay separate from live tasks and schedules on your own desk.
Remove a stale decorative backdrop reference while retaining the live theme effects.

releases.title: Clear application availability.
releases.summary: Canva now shows its development status, with new connection setup paused.
highlights: See Canva marked Under development in Apps and MCP.
New Canva connection attempts stop before browser sign-in.
Existing approved connections retain their Disconnect control.

releases.title: Personal providers. Reliable desktop startup.
releases.summary: Company models remain the default, with the original API and local provider controls available alongside them.
highlights: Fixed Windows startup when installer-only metadata is absent from the packaged app.
Restore self-configured API providers, custom endpoints, and local models after sign-in.
Keep provider discovery, model catalogs, probing, key management, and endpoint cleanup.
Select personal models and specialist fallback chains while keeping company credentials separate.
Retain the refreshed application and plugin logos throughout the workspace.

releases.title: A clearer identity. A more consistent workspace.
releases.summary: A new family of app and plugin marks, paired with real editor previews.
highlights: Refined geometric logos for the app and its included plugins.
Matching identity across startup, desktop icons, workspace headers, and the plugin library.
Real document, spreadsheet, presentation, and creative-canvas previews.
More reliable FlowX canvas access while using managed accounts.

releases.title: A smoother window. A more consistent start.
releases.summary: Refined window behavior and more reliable startup after updates.
highlights: Rounded corners across restored Windows app windows, including sign-in and dialogs.
Window controls stay in sync when maximizing and restoring.
Installed apps consistently open the interface included with their update.

releases.title: A fresh welcome to your workspace.
releases.summary: A redesigned sign-in experience and animated loading screen bring the app’s identity into its first moments.
highlights: Branded floating-logo animation with subtle lighting and motion.
Clearer browser approval and connection recovery screens.
Verified restoration of valid saved sign-ins across restarts.
